    Description
    FolderStack
    A folder stack on the right side of the taskbar: a folder Pseudo3DIcon whose hover raises the folder's entries as the same glassy vertical list the start menu shows for its application groups (FolderStackStartMenuModel), anchored above the icon and opening leftward since the stack sits at the right screen edge.
    FolderStackMenuGroupComponent
    The vertical glassy column of a dock folder stack list.
    FolderStackMenuGroupLinkComponent
    Group-link row class of a dock folder stack list.
    FolderStackMenuItem
    A start-menu item backed by a real file system entry of a dock folder stack (a file or sub-folder of ~/Documents / ~/Downloads), or by the trailing Show in File Manager row of the list.
    FolderStackMenuItemComponent
    A row of a dock folder stack list: renders exactly like an application-list row (glassy panel, MIME icon, bold label) and opens the file system entry the row stands for when clicked - files with xdg-open via Opener, sub-folders and the trailing Show in File Manager row in the lg3d file manager when it is on the classpath (falling back to xdg-open).
    FolderStackModel

    FolderStackModel.StackItem
    One entry in the folder stack.
    FolderStackStartMenuModel
    The expanded view of a dock folder stack: the very same glassy vertical list the start menu shows for its application groups, populated from a real folder (~/Documents, ~/Downloads) instead of .lgcfg entries.
    StacksPlugin
    Puts the Documents and Downloads folder stacks on the right side of the taskbar, immediately before the Exit icon.
